chapter_note: A substantial cosmological teaching sandwiched between dialogue frames. The core teaching maps the five-fold temporal hierarchy (year/month/day/hour/moment) to the five powers/way-leaders in the sphere of the zodiac, then explains the diminishing of human lifespan as a function of which power is now reigning. The substantive question — concerning Adam's begetting versus contemporary humanity's — is itself cosmological substrate (Persian dialogue tradition). Frame elements concentrate at chapter open (i=2-3), the response transition (i=24-26), the second question opening (i=69-71), Illuminator's response framing (i=79-81), and the closing worship/thanks formula (i=104-107). The fatigue score (apostolic_dialogue +11.6 in second half) reflects the closing dialogue frame at end. The teaching itself is robust and cosmologically systematic — five-fold enumeration of powers ruling year/month/day/hour/moment, with corresponding decrease in human lifespan.
